{"consolidated_memory":"**Dropped Frames in realtime/ws/session.ts: Multiple Root Causes (2026-03-06 to 2026-08-29)**

File affected: realtime/ws/session.ts (same corner across all occurrences, context carried forward between fixes)

Common symptom: frames missing from client sequence in websocket sessions

**OCCASION 1 [2026-03-06]**
Trigger: first request after cold start
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue
PR #2713 on branch fix/dropped-frames-2
Repro method: hold socket open through network flap
Outcome: throughput rose 14% to 139 requests/second

**OCCASION 2 [2026-06-10]**
Trigger: sessions arriving through OAuth provider
Root cause: error swallowed by bare except clause
Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
PR #5904 on branch fix/dropped-frames-4
Repro method: hold socket open through network flap
Outcome: cold start latency dropped 71% to 922 ms

**OCCASION 3 [2026-07-14]**
Trigger: input list came in empty
Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
PR #7539 on branch fix/dropped-frames-6
Repro method: hold socket open through network flap
Outcome: p99 latency fell from 3.7 s to 343 ms

**OCCASION 4 [2026-08-29]**
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #9974 on branch fix/dropped-frames-8
Repro method: hold socket open through network flap
Outcome: flaky test went from 89 failures per 100 runs to zero"}
